description: Overwrite one existing screenshot in a review with a new capture, in the same position. Destructive: the old image and any pins or annotations on it are removed and cannot be recovered; the title and comment change only if new ones are passed. Works on screenshots only, not notes. Takes the same capture arguments as add_screenshot, plus `item`, the 1-based number of the screenshot to replace.

claim_token.description: The claim_token from create_review (authorizes the write). For a review the human has SAVED to their account, pass the agent token they generated on the review page (Export & more → Hand to your agent) here instead.

comment.description: Optional note describing what this screen shows or what's wrong with it.

full_page.description: With page_url: capture the entire scrollable page instead of the first viewport. Default false. Pages that scroll inside an inner container come back viewport-sized.

hide_selectors.description: With page_url: extra CSS selectors to hide before the shot, e.g. ['#newsletter-modal', '.chat-widget']. Common cookie and consent banners are hidden on every render.

image.description: A small base64-encoded PNG, JPEG or WebP (data: URL prefix accepted). Intended for images under about 100 KB; larger screenshots are better uploaded and passed as image_url.

image_url.description: An image URL on Cobalt's own image host, as returned by https://cobaltcapture.com/api/upload (multipart field `file`, returns {url, key}) or by the editor's window.cobaltGrab(). External URLs are refused.

item.description: The 1-based number of the existing screenshot item to overwrite (as it appears in the review, counting notes).

page_url.description: A public http(s) page for Cobalt to render and screenshot server-side. Pages behind a login can't be rendered. Becomes the item's source_url unless one is passed. Takes 10 to 30 seconds; a site that blocks automated browsers returns an error.

review.description: The review slug or URL from create_review.

source_url.description: Optional URL of the page the screenshot was taken on.

title.description: Optional short caption for the screenshot.

viewport.description: With page_url: 'desktop' (1280x800, default) or 'mobile' (390x844 phone, 2x, touch).

name: replace_screenshot
